Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91** (period 2026-05-01). That puts it **32nd of 121 countries**.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the working-age population. At 1.0, usage matches population exactly, and 1.0 is also the global average. So Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population alone would predict.

Some context from the same data:
- **Work vs. personal vs. coursework:** 47% / 47% / 6%. The global split is 43% / 40% / 16%.
- **Augmentation vs. automation:** 53% / 47%. Globally it's 51% / 49%.

These figures describe observed Claude usage only. Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
